script.text: Artificial intelligence learned to write code...
It could only achieve modest outcomes.

textCues.text: THIS
AI CAN DO THIS
THIS
people used to say
"i have an idea"....
so many ideas dead because of...  "don't know how".
but now....
now... When I have an idea...
...I just whisper it into existence...
it's so fucking cool...
THIS
THIS
THIS
All I had to do was ask — now it's real, it exists.
From an idea, from a vibe, I made this,
Wanna make a beat? paint a dream? write an app? well, man,
Now everybody got the skills, now everybody can!
You wanted your genius to stay elite,
Now the street’s got brushes, pens and beats.
It was “real” when you sampled the Beatles and Yay,
But you hate the remix of the whole human race.
(Scared of the slop?) Yeah, cool, so stop.
But I seen bland before models dropped.
It ain’t fake, it’s realer than you—
Cos it’s got *intent* and it tells a truth.
You think it’s hollow ‘cause you can’t hear screams?
I think it’s pure ‘cause it amplifies dreams.
You blame the brush ‘cause you painted crap?
You blame the synth ‘cause your tune was flat?
You blame the pen when your novel’s whack?
Aight then, blame shoes when you can’t run track.
This ain’t Skynet, this is sky's the limit—
You're mad that a kid with a dream can now live it.
Feed full of slop? That’s a mirror, not fate, (look!)
The same crowd chased clicks before models were made, (true!)
Yeah, I hear the fears, “Where’s the soul, where's the feeling?”
Believe me when I say that A.I. art can have deep meaning,
Why did you make it? Did it capture your feelings?
The method doesn't matter, doesn't compromise the meaning.
It's incredible what we can create from nothing more than dreaming.
